claim.statement: GitHub's current service overview says GitHub.com agent entry points can have Copilot research, plan and make code changes on a branch before a pull request is created, while other entry points or an explicit prompt can request a pull request directly.

source.title: About GitHub Copilot cloud agent
source.locator: Overview of Copilot cloud agent; When you delegate tasks list; Limitations

limitations: The statement describes route options and does not establish which route a particular prompt or integration will use.
The catalog did not delegate a task or observe a branch, commit or pull request.
unknowns: The selected entry point, prompt, branch, pull-request state and iteration history of a real task are unknown.
The exact repository permissions and branch protections applied to a task are unknown.
